Name: Cheaper materials
Author: weissnicht01
Description:
Tired of spending a fortune on iron at Clint's? Need some wood to build a nice farm? Then this mod is for you!

_____________

Reduces the price of stone, wood, coal and the ores.
Hardwood, Clay, Fiber, and Iridium can now be bought.
Iridium is by default only available after you have visited the desert for the first time. ("IridiumAvailable" set to "desert". "always" and "never" are also possible")
Radioactive Ore is by default only available after you found 100 Golden Walnuts. ("RadioactiveOreAvailable" set to "walnut". "always" and
"never" are also possible")
Price and availability of all items can be changed in the config.
If you want to change these settings in-game, use the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu [/url]

_____________

Requires SMAPI and Content Patcher.
Requires game version 1.6
